outcome: Anterior and anterior-posterior walls of the uterus measurements
cohort: Women with uneventful vaginal delivery or cesarean section
finding: The study found that L5-fundus distance measurement is a simple and effective technique to evaluate the size of the uterus, and homogenous endometrium up to 30 mm in asymptomatic patients may be a normal finding 24 hours after delivery.
mod_finding: Fundus-cervix length and Promontorium-fundus length were significantly higher in patients who delivered vaginally compared to cesarean section.
